about.intro: I'm a *Full-Stack Architect & System Engineer* with **90+ open-source projects** on GitHub, building **scalable and sustainable systems**.
about.description: I'm someone who loves **learning new things** and constantly tries to put what I learn into practice. I develop *web*, *mobile*, and *desktop* applications. I started with **Sketchware** and grew into building complex distributed systems. I enjoy working with simple, **practical**, and **sustainable** tools.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Saif Fikry**, an **18-year-old** developer from **Egypt** with **5 years** of coding experience and **90+ open-source projects** on GitHub. I'm mostly self-taught through my own projects and experiments, starting my journey with **Sketchware** and gradually evolving into building complex full-stack architectures.

I started my programming journey with **Sketchware** — a visual Android development environment — which gave me my first taste of logic and problem-solving. From there, I moved on to web development with **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**, and eventually modern frameworks like **React, Next.js, Laravel, and Node.js**.

Today, my expertise spans **full-stack web development**, **Android app development** (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose), **Discord bot development**, **system engineering**, and **cloud infrastructure**. I work with a wide range of technologies including *React*, *Next.js*, *Vue.js*, *Laravel*, *TailwindCSS*, *PostgreSQL*, *MySQL*, *MongoDB*, *Kotlin*, *Docker*, and *Cloudflare*.

I'm the **founder of VexFlix** (a high-performance streaming platform) and **Santafy** (a music streaming ecosystem). I've built everything from media processing tools in Rust/Tauri to Discord bots serving thousands of users, and free APIs for developers.

I pay great attention to making my projects as **clean, understandable, and sustainable** as possible. I'm a bit **obsessive** about this — sometimes I make things harder for myself even when I know it's unnecessary.

My current goal is to specialize in **backend and system design** and make my projects more professional. In addition to this, I want to build my own systems, libraries, and simple, practical tools that solve real problems.

projects.title: VexFlix
projects.description: VexFlix is a high-performance streaming platform that brings a vast library of movies, series, and anime directly to your browser. Built with a focus on scalability and user experience, it features a custom video player, advanced caching, ad-network integration, and handles high traffic loads with zero downtime.

projects.title: Santafy
projects.description: Santafy is a free music streaming web application that lets you discover, organize, and listen to your favorite tracks on the fly. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android, with a sleek web interface and smooth playback, it transforms the way you experience music online.

projects.title: Aether Media
projects.description:
Aether Media is a media processing tool that allows users to batch convert, compress, resize, and rename media files (video, audio, image) quickly, securely, and easily.

Built on the performance of Rust and the lightweight nature of Tauri. Using the power of FFmpeg in the background, it offers complex media operations with a modern interface. Your files are never uploaded to a server; all processes take place entirely locally on your own device.

projects.title: File Manager
projects.description:
File Manager is a self-hosted file management application with a cyberpunk-inspired interface. It lets you upload, organize, tag, and filter any type of file through a sleek, modern web interface backed by SQLite — no external database required.

All files are stored locally on your machine — no cloud, no third-party servers. Upload your files, assign tags and keywords, and find them instantly with powerful filtering. The application automatically generates thumbnails for images and videos, giving you a visual overview of your entire archive.

projects.title: GXCHub

projects.title: Animated Portfolio

projects.title: X Clone

projects.title: Omnichannel Chatbot
projects.description: An advanced self-hosted omnichannel chatbot and AI platform with a visual bot builder. Connect major messaging channels, automate flows with drag-and-drop nodes, integrate multiple LLMs, and manage a live chat inbox and CRM — all built on a scalable Turborepo monorepo.

roadmap.description: I started my programming journey with **Sketchware**, a visual Android development environment. This gave me my first introduction to programming logic, variables, conditions, and loops on a mobile platform.
I first got introduced to formal software development in high school. I learned the fundamentals and logic of programming and started building my first web pages with HTML and CSS.
I started developing static and dynamic websites by learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. During this period, I also learned how to use databases in my projects.
It was my last year of high school. I significantly improved my UI development skills with CSS and continued working on web projects at my internship.

After high school, I turned to modern technologies like React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB. During this period, I developed many websites and applications. Additionally, I started writing various tools in Python for my personal use.

I started working as an intern at PostAjans, where I focused mainly on Laravel. I also built VexFlix and Santafy at scale, learned Android development with Kotlin, built Discord bots, created free APIs, and developed various personal projects utilizing Tauri, FFmpeg, and cloud infrastructure.
